title: Zesty Smoky Filipino Lamb Pancit Canton
description: A glossy, smoky pancit canton featuring tender lamb and fresh veggies, finished with a zesty lime finish for a romantic Filipino flair.
instructions: Heat a wok over medium-high heat and sear the lamb slices until browned, about 3-4 minutes, then set aside.
In the same wok, sauté onion and garlic until fragrant, about 1-2 minutes.
Add the bell pepper and carrot, stir-fry until just tender, about 2-3 minutes.
Return the lamb to the wok, pour in soy sauce, oyster sauce, and smoked paprika, and stir until the lamb is coated.
Toss in the pre-cooked pancit canton noodles, stirring to combine and heat through, about 1-2 minutes.
Drizzle lime juice over the noodles and season with salt and pepper to taste, then stir well.
Fold in fresh cilantro just before serving for a bright finish.
Serve hot, optionally garnished with extra cilantro or lime wedges.
